title: Giving Directions
subtitle: Help others find their way
description: Being able to give and follow directions in English is an essential real-world skill. These phrases cover everything from simple turns to landmarks and distance estimates.
tip: Use landmarks instead of just street names — 'turn left at the big supermarket' is much easier to follow than 'turn left onto Oak Street'.
phrases: Go straight ahead for about two blocks and then turn left.
Turn right at the traffic lights, just past the pharmacy.
Take the roundabout and exit at the third turning.
It's just on the left, right after the old library.
You've gone too far — you need to double back about a hundred meters.
It's roughly a ten-minute walk from here.
Follow the signs for the city center and you can't miss it.
Head down this road until you see a large park on your right.
